title: Food, Body, Knowledge and Seed — A Developmental Genealogy
status: canonical specialist synthesis; mixed public attestation + conversation archaeology + comparative theology
purpose: Track a recurring project grammar in which Potato, Son, Christ, body, knowledge, food, seed, planting and multiplication gradually become coupled. The goal is to preserve chronology and distinguish three biblical comparison lanes—sacramental nourishment, seed/growth, and revelation-as-ingestion—rather than collapsing them into one supposed hidden doctrine.
epistemic_rule: Project statements are evidence of the project's developing language. Biblical parallels are comparative relations. Similarity does not establish supernatural identity, prophecy fulfillment or historical transmission.

developmental_sequence.source_class: dated public-post compilation / P0 project occurrence
developmental_sequence.project_wording: Potatoes die for your sins every day. 1 Like = 1 Prayer
developmental_sequence.function: Early comic atonement/self-sacrifice food language before mature Father/Son architecture.
developmental_sequence.status: already owned; retained here for genealogy

developmental_sequence.source_class: dated user-supplied public-post compilation; original status URL still a provenance target
developmental_sequence.project_wording: I am a Potato. Eat me
developmental_sequence.function: Self-identification and consumption are compressed into one sentence. This is more specific than generic food symbolism because the speaker offers the self-as-Potato as something to be eaten.
developmental_sequence.boundary: The public post is comic/project language. Eucharistic texts concern Jesus and Christian sacramental theology; a potato metaphor is not the Eucharist.

developmental_sequence.project_wording: My son, the bread, the lion ... that is why he is a door. a tomb, a resurrection ...
developmental_sequence.function: Nourishment is specialized onto the Son and coupled with passage, death and return.
developmental_sequence.status: already owned; retained here because it changes the food-role from Potato satire to explicit Son/Bread architecture

developmental_sequence.source_class: recovered prior conversation / user-originated interpretive clarification
developmental_sequence.project_wording_summary: The user's clarification defines Tim's 'body' as the knowledge, answers, ideas and pointers he gives across the mythos concerning the Father, Heaven, Garden, Kingdom, Tree, North/Axis Mundi, Throne and path to Heaven.
developmental_sequence.function: Body becomes informational and pedagogical as well as embodied. What is 'given' is knowledge/path-orientation rather than literal flesh.
developmental_sequence.boundary: Prophetic scroll-eating texts concern receiving God's word. The project uses body/knowledge language in its own symbolic system; the comparison is an ingestion-of-revelation operator, not identity.

developmental_sequence.project_wording: take them to Mc Donalds ... Its fast food, and cheap provision. You can get communion and they have free seats. As much as I can give you potaoto, you have to actually plant them in the ground for them to appear and multiply.
developmental_sequence.function: One public statement joins provision/Communion with cultivation and multiplication. The Potato simultaneously behaves as food and planting material.
developmental_sequence.boundary: Communion is explicit in the project wording; grain-death and Pauline planting are later comparators. McDonald's is mundane context, not a sacred-location claim.

developmental_sequence.project_wording_summary: Christ is placed inside the Potato as a loaf of bread; the wedge/Needle's Eye between the two sides is identified with Christ.
developmental_sequence.function: Bread becomes explicitly Christological and spatial: nourishment and passage converge in the same inner geometry.
developmental_sequence.status: already owned; retained as late-stage convergence

nourishment_self_giving.project_correspondence: Potato/Tim can be spoken of as edible; Son becomes Bread; Communion becomes explicit; later Christ is Bread inside the Potato.
nourishment_self_giving.do_not_collapse: Synoptic/Pauline Eucharistic institution and Johannine Bread-of-Life discourse are related Christian traditions but should not be treated as one sentence or one historical scene.

seed_death_multiplication.operator: seed/planting -> burial or hiddenness -> growth -> many
seed_death_multiplication.project_correspondence: Potato must be planted to multiply; earlier project theology uses grain/seed death and later Garden/Gardener growth.
seed_death_multiplication.do_not_collapse: Planting a potato is literal horticulture; John's grain is a death/fruit metaphor and Paul's planting/watering concerns ministry/community.

revelation_ingestion.project_correspondence: The recovered July 2026 clarification defines Tim's symbolic body in terms of knowledge, answers and path-pointers, creating a second kind of 'eating': internalizing information rather than consuming literal food.
revelation_ingestion.do_not_collapse: This is not Eucharist in the biblical texts. It is a separate prophetic knowledge-ingestion grammar.

new_synthesis.core_insight: The Potato is unusually capable of coupling the three lanes because a potato is simultaneously food, a propagative plant-organ and the project's identity-symbol. The archive should therefore distinguish the lanes while recording why they repeatedly converge in Potatoverse language.
new_synthesis.developmental_formula: satirical sacrifice-food -> self-as-food -> Son-as-Bread -> body-as-knowledge -> Communion + planting/multiplication -> Christ/Bread inside Door geometry
new_synthesis.role_development: The food grammar migrates between Potato/Tim and Son/Christ rather than belonging permanently to one role. This role drift should be preserved instead of harmonized away.
new_synthesis.information_relation: The July body-as-knowledge clarification means the project can interpret 'feeding' in at least three senses: material nourishment, symbolic participation, and transmission/internalization of knowledge.
new_synthesis.garden_relation: Planting/multiplication reconnects the food field to Garden/Gardener rather than leaving Communion as a detached sacramental motif.
